# SHADOW Arsenal profiles

<!-- Generated by arsenal/tools/gen-profiles-doc.py from arsenal/profiles/*.json. Do not edit. -->

Every tool below is a package in Debian 13 "trixie" `main`, installed on demand through the
package manager: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-<profile>` or the SHADOW Arsenal application.
Nothing is installed by default. Use the tools only on systems you own or have written
permission to test — see [legal-use.md](legal-use.md).

<a id="core"></a>
## Core Security

A compact, broadly useful set of command-line and graphical tools for authorized security work: host and service discovery, a packet analyser, TLS checks, a password manager and the common network utilities the other profiles build on. Like every profile it is installed on demand; start here, the specialised profiles add to it.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-core`

<a id="web"></a>
## Web Application

Scanners, fuzzers, proxies and TLS auditors for assessing web applications you own or are contracted to test. Includes content discovery, parameter mining, a SQL-injection tester, HTTP clients and transport-security checks. Several well-known web scanners (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nikto, Nuclei) are proprietary or not in Debian and are listed separately with official install links.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-web`

<a id="network"></a>
## Network Security

A toolkit for assessing networks you are authorized to test: port and service scanning, host discovery, SMB/SNMP/DNS enumeration, packet capture and analysis, traffic generation and bandwidth monitoring. Pairs well with the Sniffing and Spoofing tools and underpins both the Red Team and Blue Team profiles.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-network`

<a id="redteam"></a>
## Red Team

Credential attacks, exploitation helpers, Active Directory and Windows protocol tooling, and pivoting utilities for engagements you have written authorization to perform. Several cornerstone frameworks (Metasploit, Responder, NetExec, BloodHound, Sliver) are not in Debian main and are listed as external tools with vendor install instructions rather than bundled.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-redteam`

### Password Auditing

| Tool | Package | Interface | Architectures | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [THC Hydra](https://github.com/vanhauser-thc/thc-hydra) | `hydra` | CLI | amd64, arm64 | Parallelised network login brute-forcer for many protocols |

## Blue Team

Tools for defenders and system owners: network and host intrusion detection, file-integrity and rootkit checks, log analysis, security auditing and benchmarking, sandboxing and firewalls. All are open-source packages from Debian; they help you watch, harden and audit systems you administer.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-blueteam`

<a id="forensics"></a>
## Forensics

A digital-forensics kit for authorized incident response and investigation: imaging and write-safe acquisition, filesystem and deleted-file analysis, carving, memory and registry artifacts, malware triage and anti-virus scanning. Use these on evidence you are authorized to examine, and keep an auditable chain of custody.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-forensics`

<a id="reversing"></a>
## Reverse Engineering

Static and dynamic analysis of binaries, libraries, firmware and mobile apps: debuggers, decompilers, tracers, hex editors, ELF/PE inspection, emulation and fuzzing. For malware analysis, run samples only inside an isolated lab (see the lab-setup guide). Ghidra, radare2 and Cutter are not in Debian main and are listed as external tools with install links.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-reversing`

## Developer

A software-development and secure-coding toolkit: toolchains for C/C++, Python, Go and Rust, build systems and debuggers, static analysers and secret scanners, container and virtualization tools, and editors. Aimed at developers building and reviewing software securely on Shadow OS.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-developer`

<a id="complete"></a>
## Complete Arsenal

The union of all SHADOW Arsenal profiles. Installing it brings in every tool from Core Security, Web Application, Network Security, Red Team, Blue Team, Forensics, Reverse Engineering and Developer. It is a large installation; most users are better served installing the specific profiles they need. The tools are referenced from the other profiles, not duplicated here.

Install: `sudo apt install shadow-arsenal-complete`

Combines the profiles: [Core Security](#core), [Web Application](#web), [Network Security](#network), [Red Team](#redteam), [Blue Team](#blueteam), [Forensics](#forensics), [Reverse Engineering](#reversing), [Developer](#developer).
